notes: B-103 (m21-fidelity, 2026-10-30; fixed by the once_per_event axis). Printed: 'Whenever a creature you control with deathtouch attacks, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.' Two Blightfangs attack: each Blightfang's ability triggers once per deathtouch attacker (CR 508.3a, 603.2c), so four triggers: seat 1 loses 4 plus 2 combat damage (14), seat 0 gains 4 (24).
